string.name: storage_unavailable
string.value: Local storage is unavailable. You can still practice.

string.name: scramble_ready
string.value: Scrambled. Make your first move to start the timer.

string.name: lesson_complete
string.value: Tutorial complete! You can now swipe to turn layers. Try a scramble challenge.

string.name: leave_message
string.value: Your current progress will not be saved. Completed results will not be affected.

string.name: reset_message
string.value: Reverse this session's moves step by step to restore the solved state and clear the timer and move count. No result is saved. This is not the shortest solution.

string.name: resetting_hint
string.value: Reversing move history step by step…

string.name: rescramble_message
string.value: Discard the current progress and start a new timed challenge.

string.name: lesson_follow
string.value: Follow the hand with a swipe, then release to complete this tutorial step.

string.name: free_practice_hint
string.value: Free practice. Tap Scramble to start a new timed challenge.

string.name: history_hint
string.value: History hint: %1$s. Swipe along the hand’s path, then release to turn the layer. Rotate the view if the hand is hidden. This retraces your moves, not an optimal solution. This session will not count toward your results.

string.name: lesson_message
string.value: End the current session and start a five-step practice solve. Tutorials do not count toward your results.

string.name: lesson_step
string.value: Step %1$d / %2$d: Follow the hand to make %3$s. Swipe in the demonstrated direction, then release to turn the layer. If the hand is hidden, drag the background or use two fingers to rotate the view.

string.name: solved_assisted
string.value: Solved! Hints were used, so this practice session will not count toward your results.

string.name: solved_saved
string.value: Solved! Your result has been saved.

string.name: solved_save_failed
string.value: Solved, but your result could not be saved on this device.

string.name: previous_save_failed
string.value: The previous result could not be saved.

string.name: settings_save_failed
string.value: Could not save settings. Please try again later.

string.name: clear_message
string.value: This cannot be undone. Your settings will be kept.

string.name: clear_failed
string.value: Could not clear results. Please try again later.

string.name: cube_accessibility
string.value: %1$d by %1$d cube. Swipe along a row or column and release to turn a layer. Drag the background or use two fingers to rotate the view.

string.name: preview_help
string.value: Drag the cube to explore every side

string.name: offline_footer
string.value: Focused practice. No ads. Fully offline.

string.name: guided_help
string.value:
Follow the hand; release to turn.
Drag the background or use two fingers to rotate.

string.name: gesture_help
string.value:
Swipe as shown on the corners; release to turn.
Middle pieces work too. Background or two fingers: rotate.

string.name: no_results_help
string.value:
Scramble and solve the cube
to set your first record.

string.name: results_retention
string.value:
Only the latest 200 results are kept on this device.
Tutorials and sessions using history hints do not count.

string.name: beginner_guides_help
string.value:
Follow the corner gestures; release to turn.
Hands and faint swipe paths appear only at visible corners.
Middle pieces work too. These guides do not solve the cube.

string.name: turn_sound_help
string.value: Hear each turn click into place

string.name: about_description
string.value: A lightweight 3D cube, ready anytime. All calculations and results stay on your device. No ads or internet required.
